unverified_boundaries: Agent routing and interactive behavior have not been runtime-evaluated.
Scientific benchmark performance, parser conformance, and human-expert review have not been established.
The bundled self-test uses tiny synthetic Newick files; representative large, deep, or producer-specific trees were not evaluated.
Only the documented single-tree Newick subset is supported; Nexus, NHX, square-bracket comments, and multiple-tree files were not evaluated.
Numeric internal labels are reported descriptively without verifying their producer-defined support convention or biological meaning.
Windows create-exclusive publication and symlink semantics have not been verified.

decision_sequence.applies_when: Exact tip-set comparison is requested but the comparison tree or exact label-equality requirement is absent or ambiguous.
decision_sequence.question: Must a second local Newick tree contain exactly the same case-sensitive parsed tip labels?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Supply one comparison tree only when exact parsed-label set equality is required; do not normalize aliases, underscores, case, or whitespace.

runtime_versions: Python 3.12.8 self-test; compatible syntax requires Python >=3.10
